title: China pledges to buy more from the world, but its shopping list is changing
paragraphs: China pledges to buy more from the world, but its shopping list is changing
CNA speaks to exporters and industry experts at Shanghai’s flagship import expo about what China still wants from the world, as foreign suppliers face a tougher sell.
SHANGHAI: Honey-sweet pineapples from the Philippines, juicy blueberries from Peru and a new variety of apple that was bred in the Netherlands.
